metadata.title: Factors affecting teacher job satisfaction: a causal inference machine learning approach using data from TALIS 2018

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variable is a continuous teacher job satisfaction scale rather than a PV-based cognitive achievement score.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that TALIS sampling weights were applied to obtain population-representative estimates and correct standard errors.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any methods that account for school clustering, indicating that it likely used student-level models ignoring school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.
